title: Business Operations Lead
description: 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. We’re pushing the boundaries of the existing healthcare system so that we can fulfill our promise to providers, patients, and payers to create access to high quality providers across the nation. In order to do that, we’re building a world class operations team that enables efficiency, growth, and quality, and as a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to have a material impact on the trajectory of Headway and help define a function core to the livelihood of our business and the impact we deliver for our partners and clients. As a Business Operations Lead, you will drive complex, cross-functional initiatives that advance pod-level objectives. You'll work independently to identify opportunities, address dependencies, and ensure alignment across stakeholders - turning ambiguous problems into structured analyses, scalable processes, and clear recommendations. You'll bring analytical rigor to root-cause investigations, design workflows and tooling that improve efficiency and reliability, and own initiatives end-to-end from scoping through delivery. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, a builder's mindset toward operational design, and the ability to coordinate across teams to drive measurable outcomes. What you’ll do at Headway Drive complex, cross-functional initiatives that advance pod-level objectives - identifying opportunities, addressing dependencies, and ensuring alignment across stakeholders. Build and operate scalable workflows and processes (0→1) that improve efficiency, reliability, and throughput across your domain. Leverage data tools to extract insights, validate assumptions, and inform decisions, synthesizing findings into clear recommendations that guide pod and organizational priorities. Plan, execute, and deliver initiatives end-to-end by setting clear objectives, timelines, and success metrics – driving accountability across functions without formal authority. You’ll be great for this role if you: You have 5+ years of experience in operational roles at high-growth companies; background in consulting, finance, or business operations preferred but not required. You independently deconstruct complex problems into structured, testable components - and you're comfortable working through ambiguity without waiting for full clarity. You're proficient with AI & data tools (e.g., Looker, Excel, SQL, dashboards) and use them fluently to extract insights, validate assumptions, and streamline workflows. You design systems with scale in mind - anticipating bottlenecks, iterating based on feedback, and codifying learnings into playbooks and standards. You coordinate resources and align priorities across teams, building trust through transparency, accountability, and clear communication. You take calculated risks and make decisions that advance pod objectives, anticipating downstream impacts before taking action. You're motivated by the opportunity to make an impact on one of our generation's defining problems: affordable mental healthcare. title: Infrastructure Project Manager

Overall Responsibilities: This posting is for an Etch SRP New Product Introduction (NPI) instructor based in Austin, TX or Santa Clara, CA . This position is a combination technical instructor and technical expert role on existing and new products. The position requires work to be conducted within the business unit (BU) manufacturing and the development lab to learn the new products under development, gain experience on the startup and sustaining production tasks on the tool, and develop/deliver initial classroom and hands-on training on the tool. Once the tool transitions to volume production, the NPI instructor will train and certify the volume instructor, who then takes over the product from a training ownership standpoint. The position will require learning, and application of that learning, on three fronts - (1) training fundamentals; (2) existing products; and (3) new product training development.  Training fundamentals will cover the training methodology, tools, materials and confidence to deliver both live distance learning (LDL) and instructor-led hands-on (ILT) course delivery. Existing products start with basic operations and maintenance, followed by trouble shooting and diagnostics, and eventually mastery of the tool. Product training development will require content development and project management skills to help bring a new tool design from concept to reality, through the development of comprehensive training curriculum, student guides, and supporting materials and technologies. Due to the scheduling of PDP/NPI product development, the NPI instructor will often be researching, gaining knowledge/experience, and developing/delivering for several new tools/chambers at a time, so project management, training/presentation experience, and technical acumen (mechanical, electrical, troubleshooting, etc.) of semiconductor equipment is required. Basic breakdown of time is: ~45% learning the new tool and gaining knowledge and experience (mechanical, electrical, software, process, etc.) and developing the course materials, structure and updating of existing courses ~35% delivering training or coordinating structured factory OJT ~20% other activities Key Responsibilities: Deliver specialized New Product Introduction (NPI) technical training both in-house and at customer locations, requiring domestic and international travel. Manage classroom and lab activities to ensure course objectives are met and adhere to safety procedures. Training may occur during off-shift hours and weekends as assigned. Learn and maintain comprehensive technical knowledge of new and improved products to prepare and present defined courses. Disseminate new information to staff, complete certifications on multiple platforms and processes, including safety modules, and actively certify others. Establish new certification requirements. Follow and engage in Product Development Process (PDP) for all NPI products at Phase Gate 3 or earlier to ensure completion of NPI course to support the tool immediately prior to shipment of second tool to field. Utilize Technical Publications and System Product Business Groups to maximize documentation efficiencies. Create and augment documentation to address gaps in released materials, evaluate instructor performance, train others in standard course development processes (Instructional System Design), and oversee course design approval. Provide technical expertise and troubleshooting skills to assist with system repairs; ensures system functionality can support course objectives; ensures all safety retrofits are installed on the training systems. Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the Global Technical Training organization and operations, as well as the Applied Global Services (AGS) organization. Inform customers of additional Global Technical Training (GTT) courses and products, assist marketing in building customer relationships and selling GTT products, analyze customer issues and needs to identify future training opportunities, and present comprehensive training solutions. Provide coaching and leadership to other instructors, serving as a mentor to less senior instructors for class delivery, technical development, and certification. Anticipate, prevent, and resolve customer satisfaction issues. Manage multiple projects of diverse scope and complexity, directing project team members. Support Early Learning System (ELS) / Alpha Site engineering in-house or on engineering tools, review ECOs, and communicate with the field. Assist Global Product Support (GPS) in the generation of documentation. Develop new procedures and Best Known Methods. Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing on the first chamber build and participate in new product final testing. Develop technical materials working directly with Instructional Designers (ID). Observe technical activities to determine operating procedure and detail. Interview personnel to become familiar with products & methods Study technical documents to integrate technology, operating procedures, production sequences, and details. Review published materials and recommend revisions. Communicate with Business Units to obtain current product information for course updates and represent GTT at product NPI meetings. title: Sales Specialist - Applications & AI
description: Sales Specialist - Applications & AI At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! You will sell outcomes across the full stack, from the business processes our clients depend on, through the applications that run them, down to the data, AI and infrastructure underneath.  Your goal is to help enterprise clients run their critical applications more reliably, change them faster, and put AI into production where it delivers measurable value. You collaborate with Account Executives and Client Partners who own the primary account relationship across Ensono's client base while bringing expertise and specialized selling on Applications & AI to build and close your own pipeline. You will bring the application and AI expertise, the executive point of view, and leadership that turn a client problem into a signed services agreement. Ensono is an AI-led company, leveraging AI in its own operations and in live, mission-critical client environments across mainframe, hybrid, cloud, and applications, so you will be selling capabilities that already run in production, not just in a pilot. Sales Strategy & Opportunity Development Own and deliver quarterly and annual bookings targets for Application Managed Services and AI, across both overlay opportunities and the pipeline you source yourself. Prospect for and open new application and AI conversations with C-level leaders, application leaders and business unit leaders, including in accounts where Ensono does not yet manage applications or AI. Partner with Account Executives and Client Partners on account plans that expand Ensono's role from infrastructure into the application, data and AI layers. Lead deal strategy from first conversation through contract: lead with a business problem, qualify rigorously, shape the solution, build the business case and drive to close. Use focused entry engagements, such as application observability and insight reviews, AI-assisted application and code assessments, data-readiness-for-AI assessments, AI strategy workshops and time-boxed AI proofs of value, to create early wins that convert into recurring managed services. Forecast accurately, keep CRM current, and give leadership a clear view of pipeline health, risks and upside. Maintain an informed view of client priorities, competitive activity, and the fast-moving AI and application services market. Client Engagement & Solution Leadership Act as a trusted adviser on how to run, modernize and improve critical applications across mainframe, cloud and hybrid estates, and how AI can make them faster, more reliable and less costly to operate. Connect technology to business outcomes, translating faster change delivery, fewer incidents, lower run cost, reduced risk and new AI-enabled capabilities into terms that CIOs, CFOs and business leaders will fund. Facilitate discovery conversations, workshops and assessments with technical, operational and executive stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify the outcomes that matter most, and prioritize where application and AI investments will pay back first. Drive client conversations by leading with the client's business outcomes, particularly around AI, working with business leaders to understand what they want to deliver on and work with the internal Ensono team to design a solution that meets that business objective. Position AI-enabled operations, including predictive incident detection, AI-driven root cause analysis, intelligent change-risk scoring and automated remediation, as part of how Ensono runs applications rather than as an add-on. Position Ensono's AI Managed Services and connect opportunities to build out a client's AI capabilities with how they plan to manage/govern those capabilities, connecting consulting (non-recurring revenue) to ongoing services for Ensono (recurring revenue opportunities). Build business cases, ROI models and commercial proposals, including SLA- and outcome-based structures, that support confident executive decisions. Address responsible AI, security, data governance and regulatory considerations credibly with clients in highly regulated industries. Collaboration & Field Execution Orchestrate Solution Architects, AI and data specialists, application delivery leaders and partners to design solutions that can be delivered and run profitably. Lead solution positioning, proposal development, pricing discussions, presentations and contract negotiations for application and AI opportunities. Work with hyperscaler and AI technology partners on joint account planning, co-selling and partner-funded programs. Raise application and AI fluency across the sales organization by running enablement, sharing winning plays and mentoring sellers on how to find and qualify opportunities. Use AI in your own selling, including account research, meeting preparation, proposal development and pipeline analysis, and share what works with the team. Partner with marketing and portfolio teams on campaigns and programs that build application and AI pipeline. Business Insights & Voice of the Customer Bring client feedback, competitive intelligence and win/loss insights back to portfolio, product and AI teams to shape offers, packaging and pricing. Actively identify barriers to customer success and help develop strategies that improve client outcomes. Advocate for client needs while balancing business objectives and operational realities. Support strategic growth initiatives and other responsibilities as assigned. We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. Experience within a managed services provider (MSP), consulting organization, systems integrator, or technology services company. 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise technology sales experience, including at least 3 years selling application services such as application managed services, application modernization, application development and support, or DevOps/SRE services. Direct experience selling AI, data or intelligent automation solutions (for example, generative or agentic AI use cases, AIOps, or the data platforms that support AI), and the ability to explain what made those deals succeed beyond the pilot stage. Working knowledge of how modern applications are built, run and supported, including the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile, CI/CD, ITIL-based service management, observability and SRE practices, with enough depth to hold credible conversations with application and engineering leaders. Familiarity with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Proven ability to engage and influence senior executives, including CIOs, CTOs, CFOs and business unit leaders, and to build business cases that tie technology investment to financial and operational outcomes. Experience in a sales specialist, overlay, or solution sales role, with a proven ability to influence without direct authority across a matrixed organization. Strong verbal, written, presentation and executive communication skills, with strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Personal fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day work, and the curiosity to keep pace with a fast-moving market. Proficiency with CRM tools, Microsoft Office applications, and sales enablement platforms. Bonus Qualifications Experience selling application services or modernization for mainframe or other legacy platforms alongside cloud. Experience selling AIOps, observability or AI-enabled IT operations services. Familiarity with emerging AI engineering practices such as specification-driven development, AI agent orchestration and workflow design, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server architectures. Experience selling into regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, healthcare or the public sector, or deep expertise in another industry vertical aligned to Ensono's growth strategy. Experience working with large enterprise and mid-market clients and participating in large, strategic, multi-service transformation programs. Relevant certifications in cloud, AI, application or managed services technologies. Why Ensono? Ensono is a place to make better happen - for our clients and for your career. We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices. title: Radar Optimization Engineer
description: Description As one of Leidos' oldest and largest programs supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the NAS Integration Support Contract (NISC) Program is seeking a qualified professional to support the FAA's Brand-New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) initiative-specifically the Radar Surveillance Replacement (RSR) Program Office (AJM-41)-by serving as an RSR Radar Optimization Engineer. The selected candidate will support radar configuration, testing, calibration, troubleshooting, and optimization activities for the RSR PO at some of the nation's busiest and most critical airports. Primary Responsibilities Represent the PO at RSR sites, executing to an aggressive multi-site schedule. Serve as an RSR subject matter expert (SME) to the RSR program office's project, optimization, and engineering leads. Support the integration, configuration, testing, calibration, troubleshooting, and optimization of radar and associated electronic systems. Configure radar tracking parameters, target-classification software, network interfaces, and integration middleware as required. Perform advanced field troubleshooting and root-cause analysis to isolate signal interference, hardware faults, communications failures, and data-packet loss. Support antenna alignment and mechanical tilt and azimuth verification, as well as the evaluation of equipment mounting, environmental enclosures, and thermal-management considerations affecting radar performance. Use spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, and specialized radar diagnostic software to tune system gain, filter clutter, establish detection thresholds, and verify system performance. Evaluate system interfaces, including Ethernet, serial, Controller Area Network (CAN), fiber-optic communications, power distribution, grounding, bonding, and surge-protection systems. Analyze radar performance data and make necessary system adjustments to achieve required detection, tracking, accuracy, and reliability standards. Document test results, system configurations, identified deficiencies, corrective actions, and final optimization settings. Coordinate with FAA personnel, system engineers, vendors, and other technical stakeholders to resolve system-performance issues. Ensure field activities comply with applicable FAA requirements, and site-specific safety procedures. Travel Expectations Travel is expected to be high-50% to 75% of the time. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's Degree with 4-8 years of relevant experience, or additional years of relevant experience that may be considered or accepted in lieu of a degree. A degree, formal certification, or equivalent technical training in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, Military Radar Systems, or a closely related discipline. Experience with research, design, development, integration, maintenance, testing, calibration, or optimization of electrical and electronic equipment and systems. Completion of formal radar training at the FAA Academy, a military technical school, or another recognized radar training program. Prior radar certification authority at one or more airports or operational radar facilities. Several years of hands-on field experience with one or more radar systems in the active National Airspace System (NAS) or a comparable operational environment. In-depth knowledge of radio-frequency (RF) propagation, microwave transceivers, signal processing, antenna alignment, and waveguide systems. Demonstrated knowledge of system-integration interfaces, including Ethernet, serial, CAN, and fiber-optic communications; network protocols; power distribution; grounding and bonding; and surge protection. Proficiency using spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, and specialized radar diagnostic software. Ability to perform radar testing, calibration, and optimization activities, including adjusting gain, filtering clutter, establishing detection thresholds, and verifying system performance. Understanding of mechanical tilt and azimuth alignment, environmental enclosures, equipment mounting, and thermal-management requirements as they relate to radar performance. Ability to configure radar tracking parameters, target-classification software, network interfaces, and integration middleware. Advanced troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills for isolating RF interference, hardware faults, communications failures, and data-packet loss. Ability to analyze radar performance data, document test results, and recommend or perform corrective adjustments. Comprehensive understanding of FAA operational risk-management practices. Ability to perform at a high level independently and as part of a small team while meeting an aggressive radar optimization schedule. Demonstrated commitment to high-quality radar maintenance, testing, calibration, and optimization practices. Professionalism when representing Leidos to FAA customers, consistent with delivering "best of the best" support. Demonstrated knowledge of applicable FAA technical, safety, and radar-system requirements. Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Public Trust clearance. Preferred Qualifications The ideal candidate is a former FAA radar specialist, engineer, or technician with multi-year responsibility for radar systems in the operational NAS. Experience with FAA surveillance radar systems and associated communications. Experience supporting radar modernization, integration, commissioning, operational testing, acceptance, calibration, troubleshooting, or optimization activities. Experience analyzing radar plots, system-performance data, target reports, coverage, clutter, interference, and tracking anomalies. Demonstrated ability to use data, metrics, and root-cause analysis to improve operational performance and influence decisions. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner with Sales, Accounting, Revenue, IT, Customer Support, and other cross-functional teams.
